bugClass.title: Stale tracker endpoint drops the full snapshot
bugClass.cause: A client or transport is hard-coded to an older tracker read endpoint and expects its response to be the collection itself. After the tracker migrates that data to a fixed status endpoint with a nested array, the request fails or response parsing yields no items, and the client discards the entire snapshot instead of reading the new shape.
bugClass.criteria: Classify another site when a runtime client or transport reads tracker state through a legacy endpoint or parses its response as the collection, and an endpoint or response-shape change can therefore make a whole snapshot disappear. The cause qualifies whether the stale endpoint causes request failure or the client fails to extract a collection nested in a status response. Do not classify merely because code references a tracker endpoint if it tolerates migration or falls back to the fixed status response and its machines array.
